name: HiroCon
blurb: A regional anime and cosplay convention in Saarbrücken with a cosplay contest, gaming, trading-card play and an artist area.
notes: The 2026 edition ran 3-4 October 2026, ending the day before this check (2026-10-05), and the site's own countdown/JSON-LD still target those just-passed dates with no 2027 date announced yet (confirmed by direct page fetch), so no edition is listed. Seed types said 'pop' but the site is explicitly an anime/cosplay/gaming convention ('Anime-Convention und Cosplay-Convention im Saarland... Cosplay-Contest, Gaming, TCG, Artists'), corrected to anime/cosplay/games. No guest-of-honor page was found in the site navigation, so guests is 'none'.
